projects.name: Buddy - Job Platform
projects.description:
A SaaS job platform (freelance) for part-time job opportunities in France, connecting verified applicants (students & individuals) with businesses.
Implemented authentication via Clerk, payments using Stripe, a clean UI with shadcn/ui, and multilingual support with next-intl. Built admin and business dashboards for verification, job management, and analytics.

projects.name: ONG Contracting - Portfolio and Product Catalogue
projects.description: A ground-up redesign for a UAE industrial supplier, with a 150-product catalogue across 13 categories and 56 sub-categories, filters and a quote cart that sends by WhatsApp or email. An admin portal manages products, categories and page content, and every page ships with structured data for search and AI answers.

projects.name: TripGoals - Travel itineraries
projects.description:
A travel platform for curated tour packages across India, from Himalayan treks to beaches and heritage trails. Travellers browse by category and destination, save favourites to a wishlist and plan their trip over WhatsApp.
Appwrite powers authentication, the database and file storage, with role-based access for admins, editors and regular users, all wrapped in a polished UI with smooth animations built on shadcn/ui.

projects.name: CoGlider - Matchmaking for tech partners
projects.description: Ideas are better built together. A cross-platform mobile app designed to connect like-minded individuals by matching them based on skills and proximity. Whether you're looking for a project partner, a mentor, or just someone to collaborate with, CoGlider simplifies the process by providing intelligent recommendations and real-time communication.

projects.name: FileGlide - Easy file sharing tool
projects.description:
A no-login, no-setup file sharing tool built for speed and simplicity.
Users can instantly share files across devices using a unique code, making it ideal for classrooms, group work, or quick handoffs — no accounts, no friction, just files.
